text:
elaine: Quick heads-up - reproducible parse error in the JS sample during long SSE streams when token rotation happens mid-stream. Minimal repro attached.

jon: Hosted or private? Which SDK version?

elaine: Hosted staging, JS SDK 2.4.0 (new sample app), using eventsource polyfill for older browsers. If I rotate token ~25-35s into a stream the client sometimes logs JSON.parse errors.

rafa: Can you paste raw SSE frames? suspect overlap between old/new connection.

elaine: trimmed network trace (simplified):

```
data: {"m":"1","p":"hello wo"
data: {"m":"1","p":"rld"}

data: {"m":"2","p":"next"}
```

But when token rotates we sometimes get: 

```
data: {"m":"1","p":"hello "}
data: {"m":"2","p":"next"}
data: {"m":"1","p":"world"}
```

Which results in the client emitting m2 then a broken m1 fragment and JSON.parse throws.

helen: Do we set last-event-id or resume-token on reconnect? We added resume-token a while back.

elaine: Server sends resume-token header, but the polyfill opens new socket before old one fully closes (200ms-ish overlap). The polyfill forwards events immediately from both sockets, so interleaving can happen. Also saw a cached chunk replay concatenated with live chunk, then parser sees malformed JSON.

jon: Two targets: 1) client defensive parsing (buffer fragments, wait for boundaries), 2) server-side fragment sequencing so clients can reorder. Short-term workaround is to gate new EventSource open until old instance closes. Which is faster to ship?

rafa: Gate on close is cheap and low-risk for SDK; long-term we should add frag_seq and stable last_event_id semantics. SDKs would use frag_seq to reassemble and detect missing fragments.

elaine: I implemented a local guard: when token refresh is requested, wait for 'close' event on existing EventSource (or timeout after 1s) before creating a new one. That removed the repro for me locally, but some staging users still see errors (likely different polyfill behaviours / quick reconnects).

helen: We'll need tests: e2e that simulates token rotation with param for overlap (0-500ms) and random packet reorder. Also collect telemetry on parse errors (include resume-token, socket ids) to estimate production impact.

jon: Suggest adding these items to plan:
- short-term: JS SDK guard (wait-for-close) + sample-app patch + note in onboarding docs
- mid-term: server adds "frag_seq" and keeps last_event_id across reconnects; SDKs implement reassembly using frag_seq
- tests: e2e harness with proxy that injects overlaps, out-of-order packets, and cached chunk replay
- observability: telemetry when parse errors occur with metadata (resume-token, client ts, polyfill version)

deploy-bot: CI: sample-app build with SSE debug logging and SDK guard deployed to staging.

elaine: Filed issues: devex#512 (js-sdk wait-for-close), infra#298 (sse frag_seq header), e2e#173 (auth-overlap harness). Linking PRs soon. Thanks! :thumbsup:
